note: Three identical Arducam B030401 IMX708 USB autofocus modules: one overhead on a gantry looking straight down from 0.70 m, one on each follower's Menagerie wrist-roll camera mount. Native capture 640x480 at 30 fps. The overhead view plays the paper's base-camera role; there is no front camera in this rig.

overhead.hardware_model: Arducam 12MP IMX708 USB UVC autofocus camera module (B030401, 75-degree diagonal lens)
overhead.optics_note: Arducam B030401: Sony IMX708 (Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 sensor) on a USB 2.0 UVC adapter, autofocus 10 cm to infinity, 75-degree diagonal lens listed as 61 degrees horizontal and 50 degrees vertical, 32x32 mm board. Nominal pinhole from the 61-degree horizontal figure at 640x480 (vertical then 47.8 degrees). Distortion coefficients are unmeasured zero placeholders; autofocus changes the effective focal length slightly with focus distance, so calibrate each unit at its working focus. Mount poses are nominal.
